entities: Robinson Nevada Mining Company - Robinson open-pit copper-gold-molybdenum mine and concentrator, White Pine County, Nevada (100% KGHM INTERNATIONAL LTD.)
profit_basis: [TAX-BASE PROXY: Nevada net proceeds of minerals (NRS 362), not accounting PBT] Official mine-level tax-base figure, not accounting PBT and not KGHM-published: Nevada Department of Taxation net proceeds of minerals for the Robinson operator line, 'Calc Net' = 'Gross_Yield' - 'Deductions'. Deductions are limited to the costs listed in NRS 362.120(3) 'and none other' (USA_Nevada_NRS362_2025.html): direct Nevada extraction cost, transport, reduction/refining/sale, delivery, maintenance and repairs, depreciation of the mine, mill and transport plant, employee insurance and social contributions, Nevada-based corporate services, development work, reclamation, and royalties paid (taxed in the royalty holder's hands) - so no interest, income tax, impairment or non-Nevada overhead. Calendar-year figures (the bulletin for fiscal year t/t+1 covers calendar t). Comparable in scope to a mine segment operating result after royalties.
